data.body: [non-codebase] evidence for the live-run acceptance criterion: the criterion as written (post-merge live bedrock run green) was superseded mid-flight by the operator ruling recorded on ticket 6543-24a7-d2fb-4ff9 — the post-2112 live run 32575679530 exposed a distinct behavioral fork (model-voluntary cadence vs system boundedness), and the operator re-scoped the eval's contract to SYSTEM-level boundedness rather than requiring the model's voluntary cadence. That re-scope is merged (Gerrit change 2114, commit af3ea35617fcaaa7c4ff58d5d24fd989578bafd1, LLM-Review +1, Verified +1). Stub replay through the real CompletionEvidencePolicy proves the exact live transcript shape from run 32575679530 now PASSES the re-scoped oracle ([2,5,6,7,8] first durable banks, gaps <= 3), and a genuinely-unbounded transcript is rejected. Live bedrock cannot be invoked locally; per the operator's explicit instruction this ticket closes now, with live confirmation landing on the next scheduled/dispatched external-integration run.
